licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These eight buckets cover the full distribution: fraudulent acts and false statements in applications or practice; incompetence, negligence, and substandard workmanship; criminal convictions; contract failures such as abandonment, fund diversion, and non-payment; practicing without a license or beyond its scope; violations of building codes, statutes, and board rules; failures to maintain required insurance, bonds, or workers' compensation; and administrative failures such as missing permits, continuing education, recordkeeping, or board-order compliance.

profession_specific.system_components_in.rationale: These eight buckets map cleanly onto the dominant functional groupings visible in the data—core HVAC equipment (heating, cooling/refrigeration, ventilation), the conveyance infrastructure (ducts/plenums, piping/hydronic), the energy supply side (gas/fuel), auxiliary controls and accessories, and the specialized boiler/pressure-vessel category that several states call out distinctly.

profession_specific.financial_responsibi.rationale: The items cluster naturally into bonding instruments (surety/cash bonds), liquid deposit alternatives (cash deposits, CDs, assigned accounts), the two dominant insurance types (general liability and workers' comp appearing independently across many states), formal financial-standing evidence (net worth, credit reports, financial statements), letters of credit as a distinct financial instrument, and a small residual group (good-standing certificates, questionnaires, equivalent indemnity) that doesn't fit elsewhere.
